title: Roles
description: The eight fixed roles this product ships with — no custom or dynamic role definitions exist. Grant or revoke them for a specific person from the Users page.
note: This page is informational only. It reflects the real role-gated endpoints as of this phase, not aspirational scope — a role's "Can't do yet" list names capability this product's design intends for it but no endpoint currently grants.
privilegeOrderLabel: Privilege order: most to least privileged, top to bottom. A role can only grant or revoke roles at or below its own rank.

TENANT_OWNER.name: Tenant Owner
capabilities: Grant or revoke any role, including Tenant Owner itself
Read and change tenant settings (data residency, external-AI reachability, telemetry, cloud storage)
Manage agents, tools, policies (including publishing), tasks, kill switches, and webhook subscriptions
Decide pending approvals
Search audit history and export signed evidence bundles
Everything every other role can do

SECURITY_ADMIN.name: Security Admin
SECURITY_ADMIN.tagline: Manages security posture tenant-wide, short of owning the tenant itself.
capabilities: Grant or revoke any role except Tenant Owner (the privilege-escalation guard blocks that, including granting it to themselves)
Read and change tenant settings
Manage agents, tools, policies (including publishing), tasks, kill switches, and webhook subscriptions
Decide pending approvals
Search audit history and export signed evidence bundles
limitations: Cannot grant or revoke the Tenant Owner role

AI_GOVERNANCE_MANAGER.name: AI Governance Manager
AI_GOVERNANCE_MANAGER.tagline: Governs the AI-advisory and tool/task-delegation surface specifically.
capabilities: Manage the tool registry and task delegations alongside Security Admin/Tenant Owner
Create and edit policies
View everything a base authenticated user can see
limitations: Cannot publish a policy version — only Security Admin/Tenant Owner can
Cannot manage users, role bindings, or tenant settings
Cannot manage agents, kill switches, or webhook subscriptions

SOC_OPERATOR.name: Operator
SOC_OPERATOR.tagline: Day-to-day user who watches agents and their actions: monitoring, not governance.
capabilities: View agents, tasks, tools, policies, approvals, the live feed, and the user roster
limitations: No elevated write capability under this phase's endpoints — cannot manage agents, tools, policies, tasks, kill switches, webhooks, users, or tenant settings

APPROVER.name: Approver
APPROVER.tagline: A single, specific capability: deciding pending approvals.
capabilities: Approve or deny pending approval requests
View everything a base authenticated user can see
limitations: No other elevated write capability — cannot manage agents, tools, policies, tasks, users, or tenant settings

AUDITOR.name: Auditor
AUDITOR.tagline: Read-oriented oversight, with no mutating capability anywhere.
capabilities: Search the full audit history and verify the hash chain
Export signed evidence bundles
View everything a base authenticated user can see
limitations: No mutating capability anywhere in the product

DEVELOPER.name: Developer
DEVELOPER.tagline: Scoped to the tool-development surface — reserved capacity, not yet exercised by any endpoint.
capabilities: View agents, tasks, tools, policies, approvals, the live feed, and the user roster
limitations: No endpoint in this phase grants Developer any write capability beyond a base authenticated user — this role's intended scope (registering/building tools) is design intent, not yet wired to a gate

READ_ONLY.name: Read Only
capabilities: View every list and detail page this console exposes
limitations: No mutating capability anywhere — cannot decide approvals, manage anything, or change any setting
